verdict.rationale: Synctera is API-first (OpenAPI spec, sandbox API keys) which inherently supports programmatic/headless calls, and docs show you can call APIs immediately after obtaining a sandbox key. However there is no explicit CI/CD guidance, CLI tool, or automation example (e.g., GitHub Actions, test harness) showing headless operation in a pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation, CLI or SDK examples for pipeline integration, and confirmation of non-interactive auth flows suited for CI.
